sal.basis: Jordanian pay is quoted monthly and gross. Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, ~8 yrs, Amman, at a bank, telecom, listed group or multinational: about 1,300-1,900 JOD gross a month (background knowledge, not verified live this run; see sources.md). Chosen 1,500 JOD. f = 1,500 / 26,000 = 0.0577, so Noura's 26,000 becomes ~1,500 JOD now and 34,000 becomes ~1,960 JOD expected. Many banks and large firms pay 14-16 salaries a year, which this monthly figure leaves out.

autoText.en: Jordanian citizens, including dual nationals, can work in Jordan without a work permit.
autoText.ar: يمكن للمواطنين الأردنيين، بمن فيهم مزدوجو الجنسية، العمل في الأردن دون تصريح عمل.
autoText.fr: Les citoyens jordaniens, y compris les binationaux, peuvent travailler en Jordanie sans permis de travail.

rule.en: Finance and accounting jobs in Jordan are mostly reserved for Jordanians. If you need a work permit, we focus on multinationals and regional offices that hire foreign specialists and skip roles open to Jordanians only.
rule.ar: وظائف المالية والمحاسبة في الأردن مقصورة في الغالب على الأردنيين. إذا كنت تحتاج إلى تصريح عمل، نركّز على الشركات متعددة الجنسيات والمكاتب الإقليمية التي توظّف خبراء أجانب، ونستبعد الوظائف المخصّصة للأردنيين فقط.
rule.fr: En Jordanie, les postes en finance et en comptabilité sont en grande partie réservés aux Jordaniens. Si vous avez besoin d'un permis de travail, nous ciblons les multinationales et les bureaux régionaux qui recrutent des spécialistes étrangers et écartons les offres réservées aux Jordaniens.

desc.en: The Ministry of Labour keeps a list of professions closed to non-Jordanians, including administrative, accounting and clerical jobs, so finance roles go to Jordanians unless the ministry approves a foreign specialist.
desc.ar: تحدّد وزارة العمل قائمة بالمهن المغلقة أمام غير الأردنيين، ومنها المهن الإدارية والمحاسبية والمكتبية، لذلك تُشغَل الوظائف المالية بأردنيين ما لم توافق الوزارة على استقدام خبير أجنبي.
desc.fr: Le ministère du Travail tient une liste de professions fermées aux non-Jordaniens, dont les métiers administratifs, comptables et de bureau : les postes en finance reviennent donc aux Jordaniens, sauf si le ministère autorise le recrutement d'un spécialiste étranger.

sensitive.notes: Jordanian CVs follow the regional Arab format: a professional photo is common and a personal-details block (date of birth, nationality, often marital status) is normal; Bayt and local employer forms ask gender, date of birth and nationality. Nationality also drives the closed-professions and work-permit logic. Marital status often appears on CVs but is not needed to apply and is a bias risk, so we do not ask (conservative, same as TN, LY and AE). Not verified live this run; see sources.md.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Amman. I lead IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 20-person finance function. I build Power BI dashboards that help management track margins, costs and cash.
bio.ar: محلل مالي بخبرة 8 سنوات في عمّان. أقود إعداد التقارير المالية وفق المعايير الدولية IFRS والموازنات على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأتولى الإقفال الشهري لإدارة مالية تضم 20 شخصاً. أبني لوحات Power BI تساعد الإدارة على متابعة الهوامش والتكاليف والسيولة.
bio.fr: Analyste financier avec 8 ans d'expérience à Amman. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction finance de 20 personnes. Je conçois des tableaux de bord Power BI qui aident la direction à suivre les marges, les coûts et la trésorerie.

culture.notes: Work week Sun-Thu (Friday-Saturday weekend); some private firms also work Saturday or a half day, and hours shorten in Ramadan. Pay is quoted monthly and gross; payday is end of month, and many banks and large firms pay a 13th to 16th salary. Social security (SSC) is deducted from pay. Finance CVs are in English (Arabic for some local and public employers), 1-2 pages, often with a photo and a personal-details block; a short cover letter or cover email is usual. Labour Law No. 8 of 1996 requires one month's written notice to end an open-ended contract; senior contracts may set 1-3 months. Arabic is native; English fluency matters on finance applications. Foreign hiring in finance is limited by the closed-professions list.
